LevelLayoutDataBlock.ZoneAliasStart: The start value for the zone numbers. Zones are offset by their local indexes to get the final value.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.name: Internal name for this level layout. It is recommended to name this something meaningful.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.persistentID: ID of this level layout. Must be unique.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.LocalIndex: Internal name for the zone. The elevator zone should be 0.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.AliasOverride: Override for the zone's number. -1 for no override.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.OverrideAliasPrefix: true if the alias prefix override should be used.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.AliasPrefixOverride: The prefix before the zone number. A common use case is to name this something like "Resource Room, ZONE". Only active if OverrideAliasPrefix is true.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.AliasPrefixShortOverride: The short prefix before the zone's number (typically, 'Z').
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.SubSeed: Subseed for the zone. Most notably, determines which rooms will be generated - change this to get different rooms.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.MarkerSubSeed: Subseed used for the markers within the zone's rooms. Determines what markers (objects) generate within rooms - change this to get different markers.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.LightsSubSeed: Subseed used for the lights to determine how the lights will be generated based on the assigned LightSettings.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.BulkheadDCScanSeed: Subseed used foro determining where bulkhead DC scans will be placed (if present).
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.SubComplex: Determines the tileset to be used for this zone.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.CoverageMinMax: The minimum and maximum coverage values for the zone. Smaller values will result in smaller zones.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.BuildFromLocalIndex: The index of the zone where this zone comes from.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.StartPosition: Where in the source zone to try to make the entrance to this zone. Will be ignored if the door is unable to be generated here.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.StartPosition_IndexWeight: Value from 0-1 used to determine which room to build the zone from. For a zone with 5 rooms, a value of 0.4 will try to build from room B.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.StartExpansion: Towards which direction the source zone will be. This direction is global - forward is looking forward from the elevator, etc.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.ZoneExpansion: How the zone should expand. Collapsed tries to take up as little space as possible, expansional does the opposite.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.LightSettings: The light settings to use for this zone, as a block from the LightSettingsDataBlock.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.AltitudeData: The desired height of the zone. Does not make a difference for starting areas of the level/dimension.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.EventsOnEnter: Events to trigger when the door to this zone is opened. Worth noting that this is different from the WardenObjectiveEvent. This is typically used to wake hibernating enemies (such as in R6C3-Overload to wake the sleeping tank).
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.EventsOnPortalWarp: Events to trigger when the portal scan is completed (this is for source zone, not destination zone). Hardcoded to be used with the portal geomorph (R6B1 and D6D1).
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.EventsOnApproachDoor: Events to trigger when a player gets close to the door.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.EventsOnUnlockDoor: Events to trigger when the door is unlocked.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.EventsOnOpenDoor: Events to trigger when the door to this zone is opened.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.EventsOnDoorScanStart: Events to trigger when the chained puzzle of this zone starts.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.EventsOnDoorScanDone: Events to trigger when the chained puzzle of this zone is finished.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.EventsOnBossDeath: Events to trigger when an enemy considered to be a "boss" dies. In vanilla, this is specific to the R6D1 kraken, making it unusable.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.EventsOnTrigger: Used to trigger events when a player approaches an object using the triggers that are defined in the prefabs (uneditable in datablocks).
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.ProgressionPuzzleToEnter: The puzzle to enter this zone, such as keycards, cells, or objectives.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.IsCheckpointDoor: true if this door is a checkpoint door.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.PlayScannerVoiceAudio: Whether to play the generic "please enter the bioscan" voicelines.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.SecurityGateToEnter: The type of door to use for entering this zone.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.UseStaticBioscanPointsInZone: Whether to use the static bioscan points defined in the tile's prefabs for scans.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.TurnOffAlarmOnTerminal: Whether this alarm (typically an ERROR alarm) is turned off by a terminal.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.TerminalPuzzleZone: The terminal data used when TurnOffAlarmOnTerminal is true.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.EventsOnTerminalDeactivateAlarm: Events to trigger when the alarm is deactivated by a terminal.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.EnemyRespawning: Whether enemy respawning is enabled in this zone.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.EnemyRespawnRequireOtherZone: Whether the player needs to be in another zone for enemies to respawn.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.EnemyRespawnRoomDistance: How many areas away the closest player needs to be for enemies to respawn. 0 means enemies will respawn on top of players.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.EnemyRespawnTimeInterval: How often the respawn check is run.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.EnemyRespawnCountMultiplier: 0-1 multiplier for the proportion of enemies that will respawn. When the proportion of enemies falls below this, enemies will respawn back up to this value.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.EnemyRespawnExcludeList: List of enemies that should not be respawned.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.HSUClustersInZone: Number of HSU clusters in this zone.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.CorpseClustersInZone: Number of corpse clusters in this zone.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.ResourceContainerClustersInZone: Number of resource container clusters in this zone. Not required for resources to spawn.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.GeneratorClustersInZone: Number of generator clusters in this zone. Usually set to 1 for the zone you'd like to place a gen cluster in. Note that you may need to reroll marker seeds for this to properly spawn.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.CorpsesInZone: Number of corpses in this zone.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.GroundSpawnersInZone: Number of ground spawners (spots for consumables to spawn on the ground, shelves, etc).
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.HSUsInZone: Number of HSUs in this zone.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.AllowSmallPickupsAllocation: Should be set to true when consumables are spawned to prevent marker offsetting between drops.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.AllowResourceContainerAllocation: If you are going to distribute resource packs in a zone, set this field to true.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.ForceBigPickupsAllocation: If you are going to place any big pickup items (powercell, datasphere, turbines, etc) set this to true.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.BigPickupDistributionInZone: Big pickup distribution in this zone, such as powercells, dataspheres, turbines, etc.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.ForbidTerminalsInZone: If true, terminals cannot spawn here.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.PowerGeneratorPlacements: Generators in this zone. If your WardenObjective is to distribute power cells, you'll need to spawn the generators for the objective via this field.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.HealthMulti: Multiplier for health resources in this zone. Relative to ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock, so it is recommended to set that value to 1. A combined value of 0.6 means 3 uses of medi.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.WeaponAmmoMulti: Multiplier for ammo resources in this zone. Relative to ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock, so it is recommended to set that value to 1. A combined value of 0.6 means 3 uses of ammo.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.ToolAmmoMulti: Multiplier for tool resources in this zone. Relative to ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock, so it is recommended to set that value to 1. A combined value of 0.6 means 3 uses of tool.
LevelLayoutDataBlock.Zones.DisinfectionMulti: Multiplier for disinfection resources in this zone. Relative to ExpeditionBalanceDataBlock, so it is recommended to set that value to 1. A combined value of 0.6 means 3 uses of disinfect.
